description: This file is a JavaScript module for the CodeMirror editor, implementing the fold gutter functionality including options, event handlers, and DOM manipulations.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Represents the state of the fold gutter, including options and viewport boundaries.

methods.name: parseOptions
methods.description: Parses and sets default options for the fold gutter.

methods.name: isFolded
methods.description: Checks if a given line is currently folded.

methods.name: marker
methods.description: Creates a gutter marker element based on a specification.

methods.name: updateFoldInfo
methods.description: Updates gutter markers for a range of lines based on fold state.

methods.name: updateInViewport
methods.description: Updates fold markers within the current viewport.

methods.name: onGutterClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the gutter to toggle fold state.

methods.name: optionChange
methods.description: Handles changes to options, triggering updates if necessary.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles content changes to update fold markers accordingly.

methods.name: onViewportChange
methods.description: Handles viewport changes to update fold markers.

methods.name: onFold
methods.description: Updates fold markers when a fold or unfold event occurs.
